answer: Protocol security relies on substantial staking collateral, enforcing quadratic staking erosion and liquidity-sink commitments that form a formidable economic harbor. Sybil clusters face super-linear capital expenditure scaling, ensuring marginal attack costs rise beyond any potential extracted value, thereby creating a prohibitive economic tide against illicit gain. This design achieves negative expected attack utility, as the financial dune of required capital and punitive slashing solidifies a robust Nash equilibrium, sustaining protocol-level consensus.
